senses.gloss:
r. 4th cl. (ई ऋ) ऋदीपी (दीप्यते)
To shine, to blaze, to be luminous or light.

m. (-पः)
A lamp.
E.
दीप to shine, affix क or घञ्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Making luminous or beautiful.
2 Kindling, inflaming.
3 Exciting, rendering intense, (a feeling, &c.)
4 Tonic, stimulant.
m. (-कः)
1 An aromatick seed, (Ligusticum ajväen, Rox.)
2 Small cumin.
3 Celosia cristata.
4 Saffron.
5 A lamp.
6 A falcon.
7 A name of KĀMA.
8 One of the Rāgas or modes of music.
f. (-पिका)
1 One of the Rāgiṇīs, or female personifications of the musical modes.
2 A title of various books, (the illustrator, the illuminator.)
3 Moonlight.
n. (-कं)
A figure of rhetoric, dilating upon an idea, or accumulation of expressions tending to one object.
E.
दीप to shine, in the causal form, affix ण्वुल्.

n. (-ट्टं)
Lamp black, soot.
E.
दीप a lamp, and किट्ट sediment.

f. (-पी)
The wick of a lamp.
E.
दीप a lamp, and कूप a well.

f. (-री)
The wick of a lamp.
E.
दीप light, खुड to divide, affix अच्, and ड changed to र.

mn. (-जः-जं)
Lamp black, the condensed smoke or soot of a lamp.
E.
दीप a lamp, and ध्वज symbol.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Inflaming, light or heat-exciting.
2 Tonic, stimulant.
n. (-नं)
1 Inflaming, lighting.
2 Stimulating, exciting.
3 A root, commonly Tagara.
4 Saffron.
mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
An aromatick seed, (Ligusticum ajväen.)
m. (-नः)
1 A sort of potherb, commonly Śaliñca, (Achyranthes triandra, Rox.)
2 Celosia cristata.
3 Cassia tora.
E.
दीप to shine, in the causal form, and युच् or ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 To be lighted, to be inflamed.
2 To be excited or stimulated.
m. (-यः)
1 An aromatick seed, (Ligusticum ajväen, Rox.)
2 A stimulant drug, as pepper of various kinds, &c.
E.
दीप to shine, अनीयर् aff.

m. (-पः)
A lampstand, a candlestick.
E.
दीप, and पादप a tree.

m. (-ष्पः)
The Champac, (Michelia champaca.)
E.
दीप enkindling, (passion,) and पुष्प a flower.

f. (-ला)
A row of lamps, an illumination.
E.
दीप, and माला a garland; also दीपमालिका.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Illuminating, inflaming.
E.
दीप to kindle, causal form, शतृ aff.

m. (-क्षः)
The stand or stem of a lamp, a candlestick.
E.
दीप a lamp, and वृक्ष a tree; also दीपवृक्षक.

f. (-खा)
1 Lamp black, especially considered as applicable to the eyes, to darken the lashes, &c.
2 The flame of a lamp.
E.
दीप a lamp, and शिखा a crest.

f. (-ला)
A row or string of lamps.
E.
दीप, and शृङ्खला a chain.

f. (-ता)
A festival: see the next.
E.
दीप, and अन्वित having.

f. (-ली)
1 The day of new moon in the month Aśvin or Kārttika, (September-October,) a festival with nocturnal illuminations in honor of KĀRTTIKEYA; the Divalī, as it is usually termed.
2 A row or range of lamps.
E.
दीप a lamp, and आली a line; also दीपावली the same.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Illuminated, irradiated.
2 Excited, inflamed.
3 Manifested.
E.
दीप to kindle, causal form, क्त aff.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
An illuminator, an enlightener, shining, irradiating.
E.
दीप to kindle, &c. तृच् aff.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
1 Luminous, splendid, radiant.
2 Blazing, glowing.
3 Burnt.
n. (-प्तं)
1 Gold.
3 Asafoetida.
m. (-प्तः)
1 A lion.
2 A lime.
f. (-प्ता)
A plant: see लाङ्गलिकी.
E.
दीप to blaze, to shine, affix क्त.

m. (-कः)
Gold.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

f. (-ह्वा)
A fox.
E.
दीप्त shining, fiery, and जिह्वा tongue.

m. (-लः)
A lion.
E.
दीप्त shining, and पिङ्गल tawny.

m. (-सः)
An earth-worm.
E.
दीप्त shining, and रस juice.

m. (-नः)
A cat.
E.
दीप्त shining, and लोचन an eye.

m. (-हः)
Bell metal.
E.
दीप्त shining, and लोह iron.

m. (-क्षः)
1 A cat.
2 A peacock.
E.
दीप्त glowing, and अक्ष the eye.

mfn. (-ग्निः-ग्निः-ग्नि)
1 Of good digestion.
2 Kindled, fed, (as fire.)
m. (-ग्निः)
A name of the saint AGASTYA.
E.
दीप्त excited, and अग्नि fire, or the appetite.

m. (-ङ्गः)
A peacock.
E.
दीप्त, and अङ्ग body.

f. (-प्तिः)
1 Light, lustre, splendour.
2 Beauty.
3 The swift flight of an arrow.
4 A property of women, extreme loveliness, brilliant beauty.
5 Lac.
6 Bell metal.
E.
दीप to shine, affix क्तिन्.

m. (-मान्-मती-मत्)
1 Shining, radiant.
2 Blazing, flaming.
E.
दीप्त, and मतुप् aff.

m. (-लः)
The sun-gem, a crystalline lens.
E.
दीप्त shining, and उपल a stone.

mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं)
1 To be kindled or inflamed.
2 To be stimulated.
m. (-प्यः)
1 A plant, (Celosia cristata.)
2 An aromatic seed, (Ligusticum ajväen.)
E.
दीप, and यत् affix: see दीप; also with कन् added दीप्यकः see दीपक.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Shining, radiant, irradiating.
E.
दीप to shine, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-प्रः-प्रा-प्तं)
Light, luminous.
E.
दीप to shine, affix र.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Armed with shining weapons; well accoutred.
E.
दीप light, अख arms, धृ to hold.
